stem: Meera eats a roti at home before going to school. In her mouth, the roti is changed so that it can easily move into her food pipe. Which of these correctly describes how the roti is prepared for swallowing?

options.text: Only the teeth chew the roti; saliva and the tongue play no part.
The teeth crush the roti, saliva moistens it and begins starch digestion, and the tongue mixes it into a soft ball.
The tongue chews the roti into small pieces, and the teeth mix it with saliva.
The roti goes straight into the food pipe without any change in the mouth.

teacher.key_rationale: Chewing by teeth, moistening and starch digestion by saliva, and mixing by the tongue together prepare food for swallowing; only B states all three roles correctly.
